items.name: Anamorphic Streak
items.desc: Long horizontal blue lens streaks shoot out of bright lights, like an anamorphic cinema lens.

items.name: Beat Pulse
items.desc: Pulses on every beat of a tempo: a quick scale bump, brightness flash and RGB split that fade out.

items.name: Bloom
items.desc: Soft dreamy bloom: bright parts of the picture glow and spill light into their surroundings.

items.name: Cartoon
items.desc: Cel-shaded cartoon look: smooth flat colours in a few bright tones with bold ink outlines.

items.name: Chromatic Aberration
items.desc: Splits red and blue apart toward the edges of the frame, like a cheap lens.

items.name: CRT Monitor
items.desc: Curved glass, scanlines, RGB phosphor mask, vignette and a faint flicker.

items.name: Cut-out Outline
items.desc: Sticker-style solid outline around the opaque part of a clip with transparency.

items.name: Cut-out Shadow
items.desc: Soft drop shadow behind a cut-out subject, with angle, distance, softness and opacity.

items.name: Duotone
items.desc: Maps the picture to two colours by brightness: one for shadows, one for highlights.

items.name: Echo Trails
items.desc: Motion echoes: wherever something moved, bright colour-shifted copies of it trail behind and fade, like a long exposure.

items.name: Film Grain
items.desc: Animated film grain that bites hardest in the mid-tones and leaves deep shadows and highlights alone.

items.name: Fire
items.desc: Procedural flames lick up from the bottom of the frame, flickering yellow, orange and red over the picture.

items.name: Fisheye
items.desc: Fisheye lens: bulges the middle and bends the edges. Negative strength pinches instead.

items.name: Drifting Fog
items.desc: Slow volumetric-looking fog that rolls sideways and pools toward the bottom of the frame.

items.name: Ghost Camera
items.desc: The spirit-camera look: anything that moves leaves pale, cool, translucent copies of itself behind.

items.name: Glitch Blocks
items.desc: Digital glitch: random blocks slide sideways with an RGB split, in jittery bursts.

items.name: Gradient Map
items.desc: Recolours the picture with a three-colour gradient by brightness: shadows, midtones, highlights.

items.name: Halation
items.desc: Film halation: a red-orange glow bleeds out around bright highlights, like light scattering in film stock.

items.name: Halftone
items.desc: Printed halftone dots: CMYK screens at classic angles, or a single-ink newsprint look.

items.name: Handheld Shake
items.desc: Organic handheld camera movement: smooth drifting, tiny rotation and a slight zoom so edges never show.

items.name: Heat Haze
items.desc: Rising heat shimmer, like air over hot tarmac or a desert: the picture wobbles more toward the bottom.

items.name: Kaleidoscope
items.desc: Mirrored wedges around the centre, slowly rotating.

items.name: Lens Flare
items.desc: A sunlit lens flare: glowing core, starburst rays, a chain of coloured ghosts and a rainbow halo.

items.name: Light Leaks
items.desc: Slow warm and magenta light leaks drifting in from the frame edges, screen-blended.

items.name: Mirror
items.desc: Mirrors one half of the picture onto the other: left to right, right to left, top to bottom or bottom to top.

items.name: Night Vision
items.desc: Green phosphor night-vision goggles: boosted light, grain, scanlines and a round vignette.

items.name: Oil Paint
items.desc: Turns the picture into thick oil paint: flat dabs of colour with crisp edges, brush bristles and canvas.

items.name: Old Film
items.desc: Silent-film look: sepia or mono, flicker, scratches, dust, gate weave and a vignette.

items.name: Pixel Sort
items.desc: Glitch-art pixel sorting: bright rows smear sideways in random bands, streaking toward the darker side.

items.name: Spin Blur
items.desc: Rotational blur around a centre point, like a spinning camera or a whirlpool.

items.name: Rain on Glass
items.desc: Looking through a rainy window: drops slide down the fogged glass, leave clear trails and bend the picture behind them.

items.name: Pencil Sketch
items.desc: Redraws the picture as a graphite pencil sketch: dark outlines, hatching in the shadows and paper grain.

items.name: Falling Snow
items.desc: Soft round snowflakes drifting down in three parallax layers over the picture.

items.name: Rising Sparks
items.desc: Glowing embers lifting off the bottom of the frame, flickering and curling as they rise.

items.name: Speed Lines
items.desc: Anime-style streaks racing in from the edges toward a focus point, flickering like hand-drawn frames.

items.name: Thermal Camera
items.desc: Heat-camera palette: black, blue, purple, red, orange, yellow, white by brightness.

items.name: Tilt-Shift
items.desc: Miniature-world look: a sharp band across the frame with growing blur above and below.

items.name: VHS Tape
items.desc: Worn tape: colour bleed, wobbling lines, a rolling tracking bar, noise and soft crushed colour.

items.name: Zoom Blur
items.desc: Dolly-zoom streaks radiating from a centre point.

items.name: Zoom Punch
items.desc: Punch-in zoom that snaps in fast and eases back, repeating, with a touch of radial blur at the peak.

items.name: Blinds
items.desc: Venetian blinds: a row of slats each opens to reveal the incoming picture, with a soft edge.

items.name: Burn Through
items.desc: Holes burn through the outgoing picture with charred edges and a glowing ember rim.

items.name: Clock Wipe
items.desc: The incoming picture is revealed by a hand sweeping clockwise from 12 o'clock around the centre.

items.name: Color Swipe
items.desc: A solid colour panel with a slanted edge sweeps across, covers the outgoing picture, then sweeps off to reveal the incoming one.

items.name: Color Swipe Double
items.desc: Two to four stacked colour bands chase each other diagonally across the frame, covering the outgoing picture and uncovering the incoming one.

items.name: Cross Warp
items.desc: The outgoing image zooms in while the incoming one zooms out into place, sweeping from right to left.

items.name: Crumple
items.desc: The outgoing picture crumples into a faceted paper ball that drops away, revealing the incoming one.

items.name: Cube
items.desc: The two images are faces of a box that turns a quarter turn in perspective, above a reflective floor.

items.name: Directional Warp
items.desc: A diagonal wipe with a warped, smeared edge.

items.name: Doorway
items.desc: The outgoing image opens like double doors as the incoming one comes forward from the room behind.

items.name: Dreamy
items.desc: A crossfade with a gentle wavy distortion.

items.name: Explosion Flash
items.desc: A blast from the centre: radial streaks blow the outgoing picture outward into a white-orange flash that clears on the incoming one.

items.name: Film Burn
items.desc: Warm orange and white burn blobs bloom in from the left, overexpose the frame, then roll off to the right over the incoming picture.

items.name: Fire Wipe
items.desc: A wall of flame sweeps up the frame and leaves the incoming picture behind it.

items.name: Flash
items.desc: A quick flash: the outgoing picture blows out to white (or a tint) and the incoming picture comes down from it.

items.name: Glitch
items.desc: Digital glitch: displaced blocks, RGB split and scanline tearing that peak at the midpoint where the pictures swap.

items.name: Hexagonalize
items.desc: Both images turn into hexagons, crossfade, then sharpen again.

items.name: Ink Bleed
items.desc: The incoming picture blooms in like ink dropped in water, with feathery tendrils and a darker wet edge.

items.name: Iris Circle
items.desc: A circular iris opens from the centre and reveals the incoming picture.

items.name: Iris Diamond
items.desc: A diamond-shaped iris opens from the centre and reveals the incoming picture.

items.name: Iris Star
items.desc: A five-pointed star iris grows from the centre, turning slightly, and reveals the incoming picture.

items.name: Kaleidoscope
items.desc: The picture folds into a turning kaleidoscope at the midpoint and unfolds onto the incoming picture.

items.name: Light Leak
items.desc: A soft warm-to-magenta anamorphic light leak sweeps across the frame and dissolves to the incoming picture under its peak.

items.name: Noise Dissolve
items.desc: An organic dissolve through smooth noise, with a thin bright line glowing along the dissolve front.

items.name: Page Turn
items.desc: The outgoing picture peels from the bottom-right corner around a curl, showing its pale back and casting a soft shadow.

items.name: Paper Tear
items.desc: The outgoing picture is ripped away like a sheet of paper along a ragged, fibrous edge.

items.name: Pixelate
items.desc: The picture breaks into bigger and bigger square blocks up to the midpoint, swaps, then resolves again.

items.name: RGB Slide
items.desc: The red, green and blue channels slide in separately, so the incoming picture assembles from coloured ghosts.

items.name: Ripple
items.desc: Ripples spread from the center while crossfading.

items.name: Shockwave
items.desc: A refracting ring bursts out from the centre, bending the picture with a chromatic fringe and leaving the incoming picture inside it.

items.name: Spin
items.desc: Both pictures rotate around the centre with rotational blur and swap at the midpoint.

items.name: Swirl
items.desc: Both pictures twist into a vortex around the centre, cross-fade inside the twist, then untwist.

items.name: TV Switch Off
items.desc: Old TV switch-off: the outgoing picture collapses to a bright line, then a dot, on black; the incoming picture switches on the reverse way.

items.name: VHS Rewind
items.desc: VHS rewind: tearing bands roll up the frame, colour bleeds, a noise bar sweeps through and the picture wobbles desaturated at the swap.

items.name: Whip Pan Down
items.desc: A fast camera whip to the down: both pictures slide with strong directional motion blur that peaks mid-move and lands softly.

items.name: Whip Pan Left
items.desc: A fast camera whip to the left: both pictures slide with strong directional motion blur that peaks mid-move and lands softly.

items.name: Whip Pan Right
items.desc: A fast camera whip to the right: both pictures slide with strong directional motion blur that peaks mid-move and lands softly.

items.name: Whip Pan Up
items.desc: A fast camera whip to the up: both pictures slide with strong directional motion blur that peaks mid-move and lands softly.

items.name: Wind
items.desc: A ragged left-to-right wipe, as if the image was blown away by the wind.

items.name: Zoom Blur
items.desc: The outgoing picture zooms in with radial blur, swaps at the peak, and the incoming picture settles from a zoomed, blurred state.

items.name: Bleach Bypass
items.desc: Silvery, desaturated and gritty with deep blacks.

items.name: B&W High Contrast
items.desc: Punchy black and white with dark skies and deep blacks.

items.name: B&W Soft
items.desc: Gentle black and white with lifted blacks and smooth tones.

items.name: Classic Warm Stock
items.desc: Rich reds and yellows, warm shadows and a golden cast, like a vintage print stock.

items.name: Clean Skin
items.desc: Gentle and flattering: slightly warm, smooth skin, natural everything else.

items.name: Cool Noir
items.desc: Almost colourless, steel-blue and contrasty like a rainy night street.

items.name: Cross Process
items.desc: Blue-cyan shadows, yellow-green highlights and hard contrast.

items.name: Cyberpunk
items.desc: Magenta shadows, cyan highlights and glowing neon accents.

items.name: Day for Night
items.desc: Dim, blue moonlight look made from daytime footage.

items.name: Desert Heat
items.desc: Dry ochre earth, burnt oranges and bleached sky.

items.name: Faded Matte
items.desc: Lifted blacks and soft colour for a flat, matte film look.

items.name: Food Pop
items.desc: Warm, juicy and appetising: bright reds, oranges and greens.

items.name: Forest Deep
items.desc: Dense, deep greens and cool shade for woodland scenes.

items.name: Gaming Vibrant
items.desc: Saturated, hard-hitting colour with cool shadows for gameplay.

items.name: Golden Hour
items.desc: Low sun glow: warm highlights, bright and flattering.

items.name: Horror
items.desc: Sickly desaturated green-grey with crushed, cold shadows.

items.name: Moody Green
items.desc: Dark, cool, green-tinted shadows with rich foliage.

items.name: Muted Documentary
items.desc: Low-saturation, natural and unfussy, with a touch of cool shade.

items.name: Neon Night
items.desc: Deep blue-violet shadows and electric colour for city lights.

items.name: Ocean Teal
items.desc: Turquoise water and cool shadows with warm skin kept natural.

items.name: Pastel Dream
items.desc: Soft, airy, lifted colour in candy pinks and blues.

items.name: Punchy Vlog
items.desc: Bright, clean and contrasty with lively colour; made for faces.

items.name: Rose Gold
items.desc: Soft pink-gold glow with creamy skin and light shadows.

items.name: Sepia
items.desc: Classic brown-toned monochrome.

items.name: Sunset Magenta
items.desc: Pink and magenta dusk glow over deep violet shadows.

items.name: Teal and Orange
items.desc: Warm skin, teal shadows: the blockbuster look.

items.name: Travel Vivid
items.desc: Deep blue skies, rich greens and warm light for holiday footage.

items.name: Vintage 70s
items.desc: Warm amber cast, creamy highlights and olive greens.

items.name: Warm Film
items.desc: Soft, golden, slightly faded colour with gentle contrast.

items.name: Winter Blue
items.desc: Crisp, cold and bright with icy blue shadows.

items.name: Bell Ring
items.desc: A notification bell swings and rings with sound-wave arcs while a red badge pops in.

items.name: Callout Arrow
items.desc: A hand-drawn curved arrow sketches itself toward the lower left, ending at a marker-style label.

items.name: Chapter Card
items.desc: A centred chapter title card on a dimmed backdrop with lines that draw in.

items.name: Checklist
items.desc: A titled to-do list whose four items slide in and get ticked off one after another.

items.name: Comment Bubble
items.desc: A video-site style comment card with avatar, username, time and likes slides up into view.

items.name: Countdown 5 to 1
items.desc: A 5 to 1 countdown inside a ring that empties every second.

items.name: Number Counter
items.desc: A big number that counts up from zero to your target with a label underneath.

items.name: Emoji Burst
items.desc: A dozen emoji pop out of the centre, spin outward and fade away.

items.name: End Screen
items.desc: A full-frame end screen: two video frames, a round channel avatar with its name and a subscribe pill, all animating in.

items.name: Game Chat Bubble
items.desc: A blocky game-style chat bubble with a tail that bounces in over a character's head, with an optional username tag.

items.name: Bold Intro Title
items.desc: A big bold kinetic intro: a colour wipe, the title slams in with a shake and echo, an accent bar wipes under it and the subtitle rises.

items.name: Cinematic Intro Title
items.desc: A slow, elegant film-style title: letters drift apart as they fade in, thin lines draw out and a soft light glows behind.

items.name: Glitch Intro Title
items.desc: A dark tech intro: the title flickers on with an RGB-split glitch over scanlines, and the subtitle types out.

items.name: Like Pop
items.desc: A thumbs-up pops with a ring burst and confetti particles, with a like counter beside it.

items.name: Lower Third Bar
items.desc: A thick accent bar grows upward, then the name and role slide out from behind it.

items.name: Lower Third Boxed
items.desc: Two stacked boxes, name on the accent colour and role on white, revealed with an offset wipe.

items.name: Lower Third Clean
items.desc: A name and role on a soft dark plate that wipes in from the left and slides away at the end.

items.name: Lower Third Gradient
items.desc: A pill-shaped gradient plate with a round icon dot, a name and a role.

items.name: Lower Third Minimal
items.desc: Just text with a thin accent underline that draws itself, fading up with a strong shadow.

items.name: Meme Caption
items.desc: Classic meme text: white Impact capitals with a thick black outline, top and bottom, each punching in.

items.name: Speaker Name Tag
items.desc: A slightly tilted speaker name tag sticker that pops in with a small bounce.

items.name: News Ticker
items.desc: A breaking-news tag, headline strip and a bottom ticker bar with text scrolling right to left without end.

items.name: Notification Toast
items.desc: A phone-style notification drops in from the top with an app icon, title and message, then slides away.

items.name: Outro Card
items.desc: A thanks-for-watching outro with the channel name, a row of social handles with simple icons and a shining subscribe pill.

items.name: Phone Messages
items.desc: A phone text conversation: four bubbles appear one after another, with typing dots before each incoming message.

items.name: Poll Bars
items.desc: A poll card with a question and three options whose bars grow while the percentages count up.

items.name: Progress Bar
items.desc: A slim progress bar along the bottom that fills over the whole clip, with a part label.

items.name: Quote Card
items.desc: A rounded quote card with a large quotation mark; the text reveals downward line by line, then the author.

items.name: Rating Stars
items.desc: Five stars pop in and fill up to a rating, with a score label.

items.name: Sale Badge
items.desc: A starburst discount seal spins in with a pop and a shine that keeps sweeping across it.

items.name: Scoreboard
items.desc: A sports scoreboard with two team names, colour chips, scores and a clock in the middle.

items.name: Social Handle
items.desc: A pill with a cycling generic glyph and your @handle that slides in and shimmers.

items.name: Stream Chat
items.desc: A live-stream chat panel: messages with coloured usernames arrive one at a time and push the older ones up.

items.name: Subscribe and Bell
items.desc: A subscribe button and a notification bell: the cursor clicks Subscribe, then the bell, which rings with a little burst.

items.name: Subscribe Button
items.desc: A video-site subscribe button pops in, a cursor clicks it and it turns into a grey Subscribed state with a tick.

items.name: Versus Card
items.desc: Two name plates slam in from either side of a diagonal split and a big VS punches in with a flash.
